Hachinoya!"{n}{n}"Don't you think the Capital burning red would be beautiful?"{n}{n}"If that troubles you, offer me three things in this world more beautiful than the Capital in flames!"{n}"I have hidden the three beautiful things in poems."{n}{n}"If you gather all three, I shall think better of setting the Capital on fire!"{n}"The first!"{n}{n}{n}'Before the night is through,{n} crossing the Road of Yomi,{n} the horn-hider!'{n}"The second...!"{n}{n}{n}'The Land of Yomi--{n} blooming in its praise,{n} the dream-seeing flower'{n}"The third......!"{n}{n}{n}'Golden-gleaming,{n} guarding the holy Buddha, the tsubakurame'{n}
